source.author: verg
source.text: Praeterea fuit in tectis de marmore templum coniugis antiqui, miro quod honore colebat, velleribus niveis et festa fronde revinctum:
source.text_original: Praeterea fuit in tectis de marmore templum / coniugis antiqui, miro quod honore colebat, / velleribus niveis et festa fronde revinctum: /
source.text_english: Moreover, there was in the palace a temple of his ancient wife, which he worshiped with marvelous honor, bound with snowy fleeces and festive garlands:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: vestris egomet tune vellera templis illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_original: vestris egomet tune vellera templis / illa dabo, dabit auratis et cornibus igni / colla pater, niveique greges altaria cingent.
reuse.text_english: Shall I myself then give those fleeces to your temples? Their father shall give his neck to the gilded fire, and snowy flocks shall surround the altars.
